rv.q: Fitzgerald doesn’t try to win you over—he just does.
So, it’s a pleasure to have the opportunity of seeing him showcased in such a challenging solo role, seeing him meeting the challenge so comfortably, so assuredly, so effortlessly, so winningly.
I'd say Fitzgerald's work here is more diligent than inspired, but even a diligent Christopher Fitzgerald is worth watching.
His performance is not to be missed.

cn.t: Critics largely embrace this Irish Rep revival of McPherson's solo monologue, with Christopher Fitzgerald's performance drawing particular praise. A compact but gripping 70 minutes.
